test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: According to the passage, what is the role of reading?

options.text: To give strength to the body
To learn new information to avail opportunity

solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2 - To learn new information to avail opportunity. 

This option is correct because the passage highlights the importance of reading as a means to gain knowledge and leverage opportunities effectively.
